headline: 0 of 408 endpoints pass the fail-closed gates; 97 of them carry a VASP layer and all 97 fail.
311 of 408 endpoints have no VASP layer at all and are unverifiable.
ICHARG=1 is set everywhere but there is no CHGCAR anywhere in the tree (1870 occurrences).
output.csv's r2 is the G(T) polynomial fit only; the E(V) fit quality is never reported.
53 endpoints' E(V) is not a Birch-Murnaghan curve (r2 < 0.99).
57 endpoints' G(0) does not equal min E(V) + ZPE (by > 20 meV).
2259 of 3686 thermal_properties yaml silently drop imaginary modes (283 endpoints).
41 endpoints' reported Gibbs curve has an adjacent jump > 0.2 eV; 9 exceed 1 eV and 3 exceed 5 eV (largest 26.78 eV, BCC-Hf-Ni-2).
165 endpoints' Gibbs curves stop at 1960 K while 230 stop at 2960 K; the TDB records no range.
The TDB's GHSER reference functions keep only 3 terms; for Co that shifts the reference by up to 576 kJ/mol.
